name: main-front is read as "Front is in types"
why: The distinction the design says is invisible today: an image can be TYPED Front without being the archive's chosen main front. The fixture makes them disagree on purpose — two Front-typed images per release, one main front — so a build that conflated them reports double.

name: the thumbnail ladder is not inspected per image
why: A missing 1200 on an old upload stops being a mystery only if the panel counts the sizes that actually exist. The fixture's second image has a 250 alone.

name: edit ids are collected but never linked
why: For an editor chasing "who added this cover and when", the edit id is the single most useful field in the record, and it was dead weight in the cache. A plain number is not the feature.

name: the panel does not say a filter is active
why: runFilter() REMOVES non-matching rows, so the tally is of what is shown. Reporting that as the whole table is the silent-subset defect the design's trap 2 names; saying the scope out loud is what this build does instead of walking source rows.
grep: says so when a filter is hiding rows

name: the panel is gated on nothing being outstanding
why: The trap the design names first. _showCaaCompletionToast() fires on the queue's onIdle and CLAUDE.md records that on a large listing it NEVER fires — so a panel gated the same way is useless on exactly the pages that motivated it.

name: the failures group offers no action
why: Zone 2 explains and zone 4 acts, and a user already looking at the list should not have to close the panel to act on it.

name: entity paths are not deduped
why: The sticky-column duplicate of a row carries the same art anchor, and a release-group breadcrumb can repeat one. Counting an entity twice inflates every number in the panel. KNOWN GAP recorded honestly: this fixture's sub-table has no sticky duplicate reaching the art anchor, so the counts do not move. Covering it needs a pageType with a sticky first column that carries one.
